title: Pilates Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pilates:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(studio_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Pilates session events land each day and how many distinct studio values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Pilates session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct studio values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much Pilates session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
